name: collectionMap
description:
Calls the given closure with every element in the given collection.
the function returns an array or struct (depending on the input) that contains all values returned by the closure.
syntax: collectionMap( object collection, function closure, [boolean parallel], [number maxThreads] )

params.name: closure
params.description: UDF/Closure that is called with every value in the collection

params.name: maxThreads
params.description: maximum number of threads executed, ignored when argument "parallel" is set to false
